# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge is short, sharp, and aimed straight at the heart of every man who claims Christ. Notice the order: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Strength isn't the starting point—it's the fruit of vigilance and faith. Too many of us roll out of bed already on our heels, reacting to whatever the day throws at us. Paul calls us to the opposite posture. Watchfulness means your eyes are open before the ambush comes. Standing firm means you don't drift with the culture or your own moods. Acting like men means courage, not cowardice; responsibility, not excuses. And being strong isn't about your biceps—it's about a settled resolve rooted in God. The battlefield is real, but so is the One who goes before you. You don't fight for victory today; you fight from the victory Christ already won. So get up, soldier. The day is yours to take ground in.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep thank God for the strength to stand firm. Then commit one decision today to courage instead of comfort.
